blocks.text: Our base defence and how we read the attack: who takes the line, who digs cross-court.

boards.title: Sample Position (Base Defence)
boards.description:
Defensive position against an outside attack.

- Cross Block
- **Setter:** Foot on side-line. Main target is hard line hit. Ready for tips.
- **OH2:** Deep inside the block. Main target: Everything high off the block and long line shots
- **Lib:** Just outside the block shadow. Main target is the cross power hit.
- **OH1:** Defending sharp hits and/or tips to middle of court
